text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival. Various event games were held, and the 'Chase Tamaire' with split teams was heating up intensely.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"—Listen up. I'm not gonna give you guys tedious orders
like how to move or how to pitch."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Just keep your eyes on my back as I throw down with max speed. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Members of Team Pocket
text_block_list.text: YES, MA'AM!! CHIEF!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Led by Jungle Pocket, they're throwing them in with pure fighting spirit! In they go!
Team A as a whole is like a blazing giant wheel!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! Make a basket and the crowd goes wild!
Fill the basket and everyone will roar!
The more you throw, the bigger the reward!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Have fun AND steal the spotlight while we're at it!? Aye aye, Captain!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
Team B, weigh anchor and set sail!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Team B, centered around Tap Dance City, throws in rhythm while singing cheerfully!
In perfect sync, just like a crew of seasoned sailors!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the competitions that followed,
the performance of their two-person team
was more than enough to capture everyone's attention.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, won the tug-of-war too!
Haha, it's just like pacing yourself in a brawl!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nice play! The timing of pulling all together
was perfect! Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectators
text_block_list.text: "The sheer presence of leading the team with her back... Unbelievable! Pocket!" "Whoa, Team B started dancing on Tap-chan's cue! Talk about great fan service~♡"

text_block_list.name: Jealous Participant
text_block_list.text:
...Guh... Those two are shining so bright,
they're totally overshadowing us...!
...In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—the next event, 'Chambara Battle,'
turned into a turbulent spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's this?! The other teams are joining forces to surround Pokke and Tap!
Could this be an alliance formed to take down the top dogs?!

text_block_list.name: Jealous Participant
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... Don't hold it against us.
We wanna stand out a bit too, y'know...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Heh. Tap aside, if you want to bring down
someone like me, that's not overdoing it at all."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Oh? And here I thought you just ended up getting caught in the net meant for me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean~? You're treating me like the garnish on a sashimi plate!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, let's stop bickering in front of the enemy.
More importantly, what are you gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's nothin' to figure out, is there?
—It's a great chance to show 'em who's the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll charge straight in—and crush every last one of them!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Woo-hoo!
Now that really is—full of romance!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, both competitors!
Not backing down from the crowd at all, they charge!
Taking down the enemy coalition one after another!

text_block_list.name: General of the Jealousy Army
text_block_list.text:
Guh…… Don't flinch, don't flinch! We still have the numbers on our side!
If we surround them tighter, even these two won't be able to……!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa. Not that I mind, but...
is that really the only trick you guys have?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll show ya a whole different kind of stunt!
—Listen up, scallywags!
Initiate Operation "Nelson Touch"!

text_block_list.name: Team Tap Members
text_block_list.text:
! The captain's orders!
Team Tap! Hard to port, begin the counterattack!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
W-What's this!? Team B, having slipped into the encirclement,
launches a full-scale counterattack!
They're tearing down the surrounding lines~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What the heck. After all that talk,
you went and cleverly prepped a scheme of your own, didn'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'd rather you call it teamwork!
Going wild on your own is fine, but winning with friends is the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess it's time to get back to it.
Leave your back to me, "partner."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmph, suit yourself. I'm just gonna run wild however I please. After all—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The duty of the "Leader" is always—to show everyone the back of the strongest!!!!

text_block_list.name: Members of Team Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-I can see it... The flames rising from the Head Chief!
Let's do this too!!
Bust right through their encirclement, yeaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "No enemy could stand before this alliance――and once the other teams were mostly swept away, the competition came to an end."
choice_data_list: Nobody stood a chance against the two of you.
Nobody stood a chance against the two of you.
I wanted to see how things turned out between you, too.
I wanted to see how things turned out for you two as well

text_block_list.text: "No enemy could stand before this alliance――and once the other teams were mostly swept away, the competition came to an end."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. It wasn't half bad,
having someone watch my back in a fight."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, right back at you!
I'd love to have you aboard if you ever get the chance.
Having you along to travel the open seas would be reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heh. Not like I'm just gonna quietly play along, though.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there's no reason to be disappointed.
—After all, there are still plenty of events left, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The crowd's gotta be wonderin' too, so
we oughta show 'em, don'tcha think?
Between you and me... who's truly the strongest!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, their two teams went head-to-head in fierce rivalry
across every event, bringing immense excitement
to the Fan Appreciation Festival!
